sentences.en: MAN: Hello and welcome to the film making podcast.
sentences.zh: MAN: 你好，欢迎收听本期电影制作播客。

sentences.en: In this week's episode, Claire Lemarre talks to us about how to become a makeup artist.
sentences.zh: 本周节目中，克莱尔·勒马尔将与我们分享如何成为一名化妆师。

sentences.en: Claire's been working as a makeup artist in the film industry for over 20 years and has lots of useful advice about how to get started.
sentences.zh: 克莱尔已在电影行业担任化妆师超过20年，她就如何入行提供了大量实用建议。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Thanks Ian.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 谢谢伊恩。

sentences.en: Well, before you can become a makeup artist on films you have to spend about 2 years working as a makeup trainee.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在你成为电影化妆师之前，你需先以化妆助理身份工作约两年。

sentences.en: A good place to get your first job would be on a low budget short film.
sentences.zh: 获得第一份工作的理想途径是参与低成本短片的拍摄。

sentences.en: Of course, this means that you'll be working for free.
sentences.zh: 当然，这意味着你将无偿工作。

sentences.en: But it's often worth it for the experience.
sentences.zh: 但这种经历往往物有所值。

sentences.en: Make sure your transport costs are covered – and remember, there's very unlikely to be any catering provided, so bring plenty of food.
sentences.zh: 务必确保交通费用有人承担——另外请记住，剧组极不可能提供餐饮服务，因此请自备充足的食物。

sentences.en: If you're lucky, you might start out on a big budget film where you'll get the most useful experience.
sentences.zh: 如果你运气好，或许能从高预算影片起步，从而获得最有价值的经验。

sentences.en: On productions like this, makeup and hair styling are separate departments – so you won't need to bring your curling tongs!
sentences.zh: 在这样的制作项目中，化妆与发型设计是两个独立部门——因此你无需自带卷发棒！

sentences.en: But you're likely to get the opportunity to work with a range of age groups, as well as different ethnicities.
sentences.zh: 但你很可能会有机会为不同年龄段及不同族裔的人士化妆。

sentences.en: Doing makeup for special effects is highly specialised, so don't expect to be offered any practical experience in that.
sentences.zh: 特效化妆高度专业化，因此不要指望能获得这方面的实操经验。

sentences.en: One problem with working in the makeup department is that it's a high-pressure environment.
sentences.zh: 在化妆部门工作的一个问题是，这是一份高压工作。

sentences.en: There are very few times when you'll be bored or have nothing to do.
sentences.zh: 你极少会感到无聊或无事可做。

sentences.en: It can be stressful but you'll see that the top makeup artists are very professional – even when they're having to work with directors who are impatient, or unhappy with the makeup artist's work.
sentences.zh: 这可能令人紧张，但你会发现顶尖化妆师都非常专业——即便面对缺乏耐心或对化妆效果不满的导演时也是如此。

sentences.en: Follow your supervisor's lead and try to remain calm at all times.
sentences.zh: 请以你的主管为榜样，并始终努力保持冷静。

sentences.en: I've worked with many very famous actors over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我曾与许多著名演员合作过。

sentences.en: At first, I found it overwhelming and could hardly speak, I was so in awe.
sentences.zh: 起初，我感到不知所措，因敬畏而几乎说不出话来。

sentences.en: That's preferable, by the way, to becoming too excited and asking for selfies.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这总比过度兴奋、向他们索要自拍合影要好得多。

sentences.en: Now meeting the talent is just a normal part of the job and to be honest most actors don't look that special without all the makeup!
sentences.zh: 现在与演员见面只是工作中的常规部分，说实话，大多数演员卸了妆后看起来并没有那么特别！

sentences.en: Every makeup trainee will need a makeup kit, which they'll be expected to have with them at all times.
sentences.zh: 每位化妆学徒都需要配备一套化妆工具包，并且需要随时随身携带。

sentences.en: Just the essentials will do for the kinds of tasks you'll be given – it won't be anything complicated.
sentences.zh: 对于你们将要承担的任务而言，只需准备一些基本用品即可——不会有任何复杂的要求。

sentences.en: It's worth looking at what the other makeup artists have in their kits – but whatever you do, don't borrow anything without asking first.
sentences.zh: 值得参考其他化妆师的工具包里都装了些什么——但无论如何，请务必先征得同意再借用任何物品。

sentences.en: It's very important to build your portfolio.
sentences.zh: 建立个人作品集非常重要。

sentences.en: You should take photos of all the work you do and ideally show the different stages of makeup application if you can.
sentences.zh: 你应该为自己完成的所有工作拍照，理想情况下，最好能展示化妆过程的不同阶段。

sentences.en: But remember you'll need to get approval from the makeup designer in charge of the department.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，你必须事先获得负责该部门的化妆设计师的批准。

sentences.en: As you'll be sending your portfolio digitally, you won't need to get photos printed.
sentences.zh: 由于你的作品集将以数字形式发送，因此无需冲洗照片。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So what does a makeup trainee actually do?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，化妆学徒实际上要做些什么呢？

sentences.en: You need to think about whether you're the right kind of person to do the job and whether you'd enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 你需要思考自己是否适合这份工作，以及是否真的会享受这份工作。

sentences.en: So, to give you some idea, here are some of the things you might be required to do.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了让你有个大致了解，以下是一些你可能被要求完成的任务。

sentences.en: You may be asked to help prep an actor ready for makeup.
sentences.zh: 你可能会被要求协助演员做好上妆前的准备工作。

sentences.en: Some actors will arrive having already cleansed and moisturized their skin.
sentences.zh: 有些演员到场时已经完成了洁面和保湿护肤。

sentences.en: But sometimes you'll need to step in and get this done without wasting any time, otherwise the makeup artist will get behind schedule.
sentences.zh: 但有时你需要迅速介入并完成这些步骤，否则化妆师的工作进度就会延误。

sentences.en: Trainees play a useful role in continuity.
sentences.zh: 学徒在妆容连贯性方面发挥着重要作用。

sentences.en: It will be your responsibility to take photos, log them digitally and print out a hard copy to put in each actor's file.
sentences.zh: 你需要负责拍照、将照片以数字方式归档，并打印一份纸质版放入每位演员的档案中。

sentences.en: This information needs to be kept in good order as a reshoot can mean replicating makeup months later.
sentences.zh: 这些信息必须妥善保存，因为补拍可能意味着数月后重新复制同样的妆容。

sentences.en: General duties mean doing anything from getting the teas and coffees to putting on a wash.
sentences.zh: 日常杂务包括从沏茶倒咖啡到洗衣服等各种事情。

sentences.en: Having a positive attitude and being willing to do whatever is asked of you will help you get your next film job.
sentences.zh: 保持积极的态度，并乐于接受任何交办的任务，将有助于你获得下一部电影的工作机会。

sentences.en: You won't be asked to apply makeup to any of the principal cast, only the extras.
sentences.zh: 你不会被要求为任何主要演员化妆，仅需为群演化妆。

sentences.en: If there are dozens of extras involved you'll need to keep up a swift pace and not spend too long on each person.
sentences.zh: 如果涉及到几十个临时演员，你就需要保持快速的节奏，不能在每个人身上花费太多时间。

sentences.en: It takes quite a lot of confidence to be able to do this well.
sentences.zh: 要很好地做到这一点，需要相当大的信心。

sentences.en: OK now about terms and conditions....
sentences.zh: 好的，现在来谈谈条款和条件……
